Information about Council

Council is the primary decision making body for the Corporation of the City of Adelaide.

Council is accountable to the city community for city leadership and strategy development that delivers benefit for all South Australians. Council is also responsible for the delivery of efficient and effective local government services that respond to the community’s needs.

Information about Council

Council is the primary decision making body for the Corporation of the City of Adelaide.

Council is accountable to the city community for city leadership and strategy development that delivers benefit for all South Australians. Council is also responsible for the delivery of efficient and effective local government services that respond to the community’s needs.

Council is the primary decision making body for the Corporation of the City of Adelaide.

Council is accountable to the city community for city leadership and strategy development that delivers benefit for all South Australians. Council is also responsible for the delivery of efficient and effective local government services that respond to the community’s needs.

Information about Council

Council is the primary decision making body for the Corporation of the City of Adelaide.

Council is accountable to the city community for city leadership and strategy development that delivers benefit for all South Australians. Council is also responsible for the delivery of efficient and effective local government services that respond to the community’s needs.

View the Code of Practice for Council Meeting Procedures.

Information about Council Assessment Panel

The Council Assessment Panel (CAP) is established under the Planning, Development and Infrastructure Act 2016 (PDI Act). The role of CAP is to assist Council with the assessment and determination of development applications against the relevant provisions of the Planning and Design Code.
